name: Kingdom Trek
author: Dandyhorse
description: Save the kingdom a ride at a time: your workout earns Energy, Energy walks you between towns, and you fight by pushing harder.

variants.name: Kingdom Trek
variants.description: One hero on either machine. Energy comes from your effort against your own steady pace, so a level takes everyone about the same time.

effortFrom.label: Effort from
effortFrom.description: What turns your workout into Energy. Heart rate lags by up to a minute, so fights feel slower.

hills.label: Hills
hills.description: The game sets your incline (treadmill) or grade (bike) from the road. Turn on if your treadmill doesn't report its incline.
